title: Base-change formula for the right adjoint on the self-product
statement: Let S and X be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to S be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite presentation, and let P=X\times_S X with projections pr_1,pr_2. Suppose a is a right adjoint to Rf_* and b is a right adjoint to R(pr_2)_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Then there is a canonical isomorphism b(\mathcal O_X)\cong L\operatorname{pr}_1^*a(\mathcal O_S) in the derived category of quasi-coherent complexes on P.

source.place: Tag 0E2P, proof of Lemma 48.12.8, invoking Lemma 48.12.4

proof.text: Apply the general proper-flat base-change theorem [lem-sc-proper-flat-right-adjoint-basechange] with Y'=X, g=f, and with the original morphism f:X\to S. The resulting cartesian square is P=X\times_S X with g_X=\operatorname{pr}_1 and f'=\operatorname{pr}_2. The hypotheses hold because S and X are Noetherian, while the given f is proper, flat, and of finite presentation.

source.place: Tag 0E2P, proof of Lemma 48.12.8, cartesian square and invocation of Lemma 48.12.4 (Tag 0AAB)

proof.text: Under this specialization, a'=b is the chosen right adjoint to R(\operatorname{pr}_2)_*, g^*=Lf^*, and g_X^*=L\operatorname{pr}_1^*. Evaluating the canonical base-change isomorphism of Step 1 at K=\mathcal O_S, and using the canonical structure-sheaf pullback isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf] for f, gives Lf^*\mathcal O_S\cong\mathcal O_X and hence the canonical isomorphism b(\mathcal O_X)\cong L\operatorname{pr}_1^*a(\mathcal O_S).
